Plot the annual output of the 3DCMCCFEM model

Source: R/plot_output_3DFEM.R
plot_output_3DFEM.Rd

plot_output_3DFEM plot the variables in the output file of the model (e.g., generated by the function run_3DCMCCFEM).

Usage

plot_output_3DFEM(
  output_3DFEM,
  x = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  site_name = NULL,
  year_range = NULL,
  window = NULL,
  text_size = 40,
  save_plot = FALSE,
  outdir = NULL
)

Arguments

output_3DFEM

Character: path to the model output file.

x

Character vector of length 1: variable name to be plotted in the x-axis. If not provided will be set to the variable "YEAR"

y

Character vector: variable name to be plotted in the y-axis. Could be of length >1 if x is NULL. In this case variables will be plotted on different facets

site_name

character vector of length 1: site name to be plotted as title. Optional

year_range

numeric vector of length 2: starting and ending year from which to plot the data. It will be sorted in ascending order

window

Numeric: dimension of the focal window for compute the rolling mean. Expressed in years Default to NULL (rolling mean is not plotted).

text_size

Numeric: base size of the text in the plot. Default to 40.

save_plot

Logical: Should plots be saved in outdir? Default to FALSE.

outdir

Character: path to the output directory.

Value

A ggplot object if save_plot=FALSE, invisible otherwise. If save_plot=TRUE the function save in outdir a png file. The file name will be constructed based on the argument provided (x, y, site_name, year_range, and window)

Details

The function plots the time series of the variables specified by y. The window argument should be appropriate to the desired time frame. If x is provided, a scatterplot of the x vs y variable will be plotted and the window argument will be ignored.

See also

run_3DCMCCFEM
